steps.content: In the candy forest, Norma stands beneath a tree laden with lollipops, watching in deadpan despair as a spring-legged monkey hops around nearby, clutching her monitoring model.
Norma can only sigh inwardly at the sight. There's no sense in getting angry at a monkey.
After parting ways with the Chief and the others, she continues toward the other monitoring points to calibrate her data.
And so, after passing through a forest made of lollipops and swimming across a coffee-flavored lake, she arrives at the location of her monitoring model.

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: Locating it is simple enough. Retrieving it from the monkey, however, presents a logistical problem.

She makes a grab for it, only for the monkey to dance effortlessly aside, its spring legs propelling it a full three meters upward. She tries coaxing it with a candy banana; the monkey snatches the offering and bounds off still clutching the monitoring model, putting even more distance between them.

She even tries mimicking the monkey's gestures, making a show of offering to return something. The monkey waves toward the forest, and within a moment, seven or eight of its kind burst out and launch into a game of pass-the-parcel with her device.

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: ...At this point, I'm beginning to wonder which of us is the real monkey.
Watching her monitoring model get tossed from hand to hand, Norma adjusts her glasses. The monkeys grow increasingly gleeful; one even bonks a companion on the head with it.

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: The experience from before confirms that conventional methods are ineffective here. But ineffective doesn't mean I'm out of options.
She takes a step forward, weaving through the frenzied monkeys, and extends her hand toward the distorted sky draped in Mania—

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: I follow rules... but only when those rules are fair!

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: If this world operates on chaos, then... I'll rewrite the rules myself!
Mania disperses outward in a sudden wave. The monkey troop scatters. A rift splits through the fabric of space, and Norma is swallowed into the other dimension once again.
